item.title: Novo Holdings and Alnylam Obesity Drug
item.description:
• Summary: Novo Holdings, the investment arm of Novo Nordisk, has backed a European fund as part of its strategy in metabolic diseases. Meanwhile, Alnylam Pharmaceuticals has advanced its second obesity drug candidate into clinical trials, expanding its RNAi-based pipeline targeting metabolic disorders. The drug aims to address obesity, a key area in the cardio-renal-metabolic space.
  • MoAs: RNA interference (RNAi) targeting metabolic pathways involved in energy balance and appetite regulation.
  • Sources: Endpoints News

item.title: Otsuka Kidney Drug Voyxact
item.description:
• Summary: Otsuka Pharmaceutical reported positive results from a study of its kidney drug Voyxact (voclosporin? - but the article uses "Voyxact"). The therapy is being developed for chronic kidney disease and demonstrated efficacy in reducing proteinuria and preserving renal function. The data support its potential as a new treatment option for patients with kidney disease.
  • MoAs: Not specified in the provided article; likely an endothelin receptor antagonist or a calcineurin inhibitor, but exact mechanism from internal knowledge is unclear.
  • Sources: STAT News
